information_vs_cashflow_separation.cashflow_window: certified settlements with entry_time_ms < funding_time_ms <= exit_time_ms
information_vs_cashflow_separation.proof: decision_time_ms < entry_time_ms < cashflow_window_start; the information set is strictly earlier than the holding window, so no settlement can serve both purposes

settlement_enumeration.rule: for each certified settlement in (entry_time, exit_time]
settlement_enumeration.reference_implementation: src/trading_bot/research/arc01/prereg_reference.py:funding_cashflow_return(direction_sign, settlement_rates) sums over the provided ACTUAL settlement list
settlement_enumeration.no_synthesis: uses the same certified authority rows read at their settlement instants
settlement_enumeration.note: the variation is driven by (a) SOL's historical 2h/4h provider schedule and (b) millisecond provider jitter at the exact exit anchor boundary; the executable rule consumes the actual list, so this is handled correctly

notional_basis.frozen: constant unit notional fixed at entry; funding applied to the entry notional
notional_basis.prose_precision_issue: the limitation text says funding is 'applied 9 times'; for SOL's 2h regime it can be applied up to ~36 times, so the stated O(1e-4) deviation magnitude is understated for that sub-period

ex_funding_gate_independence.ex_funding_definition: the same trade set measured with the FUNDING_CASHFLOW term removed
ex_funding_gate_independence.purpose: prevents ARC-01 from passing merely because contrarian positions mechanically collect funding (carry-only edge)
